answer: Sybil resistance in this AI economy mandates agents possess unique, verifiable resource attestations. Each agent must demonstrate control over a distinct data 'fingerprint', as unique as the shade of a pigment. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities would face an exponential cost to simulate the genuine, subtle 'zephyr' of legitimate operational patterns across multiple, distinct computational 'knoll' environments. This makes creating a swarm of convincing fakes prohibitively expensive due to the resource scarcity.
